scene.speaker: ingrid
scene.bubble: Kili found an old bottle on the beach… with a REAL treasure map inside! Expedition, assemble!
scene.intro: Kili found an old bottle on the beach with a REAL map inside! Ingrid unfolds it carefully: go north from the harbour, then east along the cliffs, then south at the third rock, and dig where the two paths cross. West of that point there is only the sea. They walk all afternoon and find… another bottle, with another map. Can YOU follow directions? Grab a compass!

data.script: Ingrid: The map says: start at the lighthouse door. … Ingrid: Walk thirty steps north, to the three black rocks. … Ingrid: Now turn east, towards the old boat. … Ingrid: Kili sees something from the sky — a circle of white stones! … Ingrid: The cross is in the middle of the circle. Dig, team, dig! … Ingrid: There's a wooden box! Inside… old coins and a letter! … Ingrid: The letter says: "Congratulations, explorers. This treasure was hidden by the lighthouse keepers of 1926." … Ingrid: One hundred years ago! This goes straight to the town museum!
